integrityNotes: Git commit, tree, and blob identities are preferred over mutable branch names.
An arXiv version identifier is treated as the immutable paper identity when local PDF bytes are not stored.
Mutable living standards are capture-dated and must be rechecked before external submission or benchmark execution.
The independent-conception baseline and integration baseline are both preserved because a concurrent scheduler merge occurred after conception but before protected review.
This registry records provenance; it does not establish scientific correctness of any source.
